name: ギャラクシー・スター
css: /* ▼▼▼ 修正: 背景を完全に透過 ▼▼▼ */
.roulette-wrapper { width: 480px !important; height: 480px !important; position: absolute !important; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); margin: 0 !important; }

.outer-ring { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 520px; height: 520px; border-radius: 50%; background: conic-gradient(#ffd700, #ffec8b, #ffd700, #b8860b, #ffd700); box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.4), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); animation: ringRotate 10s linear infinite; pointer-events: none; }
@keyframes ringRotate { from { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg); } to { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(360deg); } }
.hub-content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; pointer-events: none; }
.hub-text { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 900; color: #5c4002; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.6); font-family: 'Arial Black', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 1px; }
/* ▼▼▼ 修正: ポインターをさらに小さく (30px/40px) ▼▼▼ */

#result { font-size: 40px; font-weight: bold; color: #ffd700; text-shadow: 0 0 10px #b8860b, 0 0 30px #ffd700; font-family: 'Yu Gothic', sans-serif; position: absolute; top: 600px; width: 100%; text-align: center; pointer-events: none; user-select: none; }

#legend-area { top: 570px !important; right: 20px !important; width: 160px !important; max-height: 150px !important; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8) !important; border: 2px solid #ffd700 !important; color: #ffd700 !important; pointer-events: none; }
